paragraphs: AI: "Using AI, mathematician claims to have solved one of math’s great mysteries" (The Washington Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "CIEN Targets a $50B Market: How AI Could Expand Its Growth Opportunity" (The Globe and Mail).

Political: "Trump admin quietly releases government’s Bigfoot files: ‘Very uneasy feeling’" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Democratic Sen.-elect Colom responds to Trump's praise" (The Hill).

Economic: "‘Look at India’: Trump cites 7% growth to press US Fed for lower interest rates" (Open Magazine) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Look At India: Trump Cites 7% GDP Growth, Says US Could Achieve 20% GDP With Lower Interest Rates, Calls Fed" (Free Press Journal).

Financial: "Judge Approves $7 Billion Settlement Over Claims That Roundup Caused Cancer" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Mamdani dodges pointed question on economics of taxpayer-funded grocery stores" (Fox Business).

Geopolitical: "Katie Miller reposts then deletes Trump’s ‘whole civilization will die tonight’ warning on Iran" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "College freshman strikes gold on first archaeology dig as students uncover ancient Roman treasures" (New York Post).
